# Chekhov Dramaturgy

Curated by Skill Harbor — a deep Chekhovian dramaturgy method distilled from the complete plays, Chekhov's letters, rehearsal notes, and Chinese criticism: four-act mood-based structure without a central climax, major events kept off-stage, the "correct answer stated in Act 1 and refused," one-way love chains, subtext-heavy dialogue with half-step-off responses, three-layer endings, and revision discipline — including how The Wood Demon was rewritten into Uncle Vanya. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @jtydhr88. Honest caveats: primarily Chinese-language scholarship with translated quotes; companion reference.md carries the per-play tables — fetch the whole repo. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
